name: Longhorn 2048 Rules
mustRules: Implement only standard classic 2048 rules on a 4x4 grid with no gameplay modifiers
Provide exactly two backend capabilities in v1: score submission and leaderboard retrieval
Persist leaderboard records with nickname, best score, and date only
Overwrite an existing nickname record only when a newly submitted score is higher
Optimize UI and controls for mobile web touch interaction and responsive small screens
Validate nickname and submission payloads on the server before writing leaderboard data
mustNotRules: Must not require account creation, authentication, or session-based user identity
Must not include social features, alternate game modes, moderation dashboards, or admin tooling
niceToHave: Animate leaderboard rank transitions or score highlights in an arcade style
Store the last used nickname locally to speed up repeat submissions
Add lightweight sound effects for milestone celebrations if performance remains smooth
